label: Diagram 11.2
caption: Diagram 11.2 Renovation of a thermal element from the inside
description: The drawing is a perspective view looking into a room corner, showing three wall surfaces. The left and right surfaces are grey, and each contains a narrow vertical window set in a frame with a central cross bar. The central surface is a green wall, with a square four‑pane window in its upper middle. A rectangular patch in the lower left corner of this green wall is marked with diagonal green hatching on a white ground, while the remainder of the green wall is plain green. Above the view, running text reads: "For example, if plaster is being removed from the inner side of a wall, the area of the thermal element is the area of external wall as viewed from inside the room." A legend on the right gives two swatches: a diagonally hatched square labelled "Area of the thermal element being renovated" and a plain green square labelled "Total area of the thermal element", so the hatched patch relates to a part of the green wall. A green band along the bottom reads "Diagram 11.2 Renovation of a thermal element from the inside".
